experiment.route: original publicly released pretrained embedding with separately initialized trainable generator head
experiment.training_schedule: one fixed first pass, no intermediate DEV checkpoint selection
experiment.checkpoint_private_backup: remote bytes and full parameter, optimizer, RNG restore independently verified; external base and runtime dependencies retained

evaluation.baseline: exact previously sealed step0 candidate menus from the same route (reused, not regenerated)
evaluation.generation_and_label_order: all target-free menus sealed before reading the fixed development targets

limitations: Small improvement on a repeatedly inspected development benchmark; not a fresh blind evaluation or statistical proof.
This is candidate-generation research, not a claim that end-to-end input-method accuracy meets the project target.
Loss ineligibility follows the declared graph/objective rules and is not by itself proof of a missing dictionary entry.
Original public pretraining corpus overlap with final acceptance text has not been certified; no final acceptance samples or labels were opened in this experiment.
Private backups require retained external fixed base, embedding/vocabulary reconstruction and runtime dependencies; they are not a blank-machine recovery certification.
No Windows host installation, product acceptance, release, or model adoption is claimed.
